title: My Body: English Practice
summary: Practise English words for body and face parts.
keyIdeas: Words such as head, arms and legs name body parts.
On our face, we have eyes, ears, a nose and a mouth.
Many plurals add -s, as in hand → hands. Some change differently, as in foot → feet.

activities.prompt: What do you use to see? 👀
activities.explanation: We use our eyes to see.

activities.prompt: Touch your head! 🙆‍♂️ Which Spanish word names this body part?
activities.hint: It is at the top of your body.

activities.prompt: A person has got two mouths. 👄
activities.explanation: A person normally has one mouth, rather than two.

activities.prompt: Match each English body word to its Spanish meaning.
activities.explanation: Nose means nariz, hand means mano, foot means pie, and ear means oreja.
We clap with our hands: 'Clap your hands!'.

activities.prompt: Sort these parts into face parts or the rest of the body.
activities.explanation: The mouth and nose are on the face. Legs and arms belong to the rest of the body.

activities.prompt: Put these body parts in order from top to bottom.
activities.explanation: From top to bottom: head, shoulders, knees and toes.

activities.prompt: Hugo kicks the ball with his... ⚽
activities.explanation: We use a foot to kick a football.
activities.hint: It is at the end of a leg.

activities.prompt: Aisha listens to music through headphones. Complete the sentence.
activities.explanation: We hear sounds with our ears.

activities.prompt: Read about Toby the friendly monster and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Toby has one green eye and four blue arms.
activities.title: Toby the Monster
activities.text: Hello! I am Toby. I am a monster. I have got one big green eye. I have got two big ears. I have got four blue arms! Can you clap with me?

questions.prompt: How many eyes has Toby got?
questions.explanation: Toby says he has one big green eye.
Toby says he has four blue arms.
